title: Weeknight Mexican Chicken Lasagna
description: This quick and easy 'lasagna' is full of Mexican flavors and uses leftover chicken, salsa, refried beans, corn, cheese, and layers of corn tortillas in place of noodles.
ingredients: 3 cups chopped grilled boneless, skinless chicken thighs
2.5 cups shredded Mexican-style cheese blend, divided

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Spread 1/2 cup salsa on bottom of prepared baking dish; cover with a layer of corn tortillas. Cover entire bottom of dish; tear tortillas to fit any empty spaces.

Spread 3/4 cup refried beans on tortillas; top with corn, 1 cup salsa, and 1 cup cheese. Add another layer corn tortillas. Spread remaining 3/4 cup refried beans on tortillas; top with chicken, 1 cup salsa, and 1 cup cheese. Add another layer corn tortillas; pour remaining 1 1/2 cups salsa over top, then sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven, 20 to 25 minutes.
